title: GTA 6 Gameplay, Screenshots & South Park Appearance Revealed as PS5 Launch Nears
description: Just three weeks before the PS5 launch, GTA 6 makes a surprise appearance in South Park, revealing new gameplay, screenshots, and details from Rockstar.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## The Final Countdown to the PS5 Launch

With exactly three weeks remaining until the highly anticipated release of *GTA 6* on PlayStation 5, gaming media outlet Push Square reports that Rockstar is pulling out all the stops for players who are still on the fence. While many fans have already made up their minds about diving into the next-gen open-world epic—and details regarding release times and preload dates are already circulating—new gameplay, screenshots, and details have just surfaced in the most unexpected way possible.

## A Surprise Appearance in South Park

In what is surely one of the most unconventional marketing crossovers in recent memory, *GTA 6* briefly appeared in an episode of *South Park* (yes, really). As captured in the broadcast, a TV presenter takes center stage to showcase actual *GTA 6* gameplay running inside the animated series. 

The footage specifically highlights a wonderfully absurd interaction: the ability to throw dog poo at unsuspecting people walking past. It is classic, unfiltered Rockstar chaos, presented right on the television screen of a satirical cartoon.

## What This Means for Fans

For those eagerly awaiting the PS5 launch, these fresh glimpses of gameplay and screenshots serve as a timely reminder of the immersive and interactive world Rockstar has crafted. Whether you are fully prepared for launch day or looking closely at the final details before committing, the countdown has officially entered its final three-week phase.

## Editor's Take

Rockstar dropping *GTA 6* gameplay through *South Park* of all places is a masterclass in unexpected viral marketing. Throwing dog poo at pedestrians perfectly captures the anarchic spirit we expect from the franchise. The wait is almost over, and the hype train has no brakes.
